## `channel_subscribed`

The customer subscribed to email, SMS or push.

**Sources:** browser, server · **Version:** 1 · **Aliases:** `email_subscribed`, `sms_subscribed`, `push_opted_in`

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `message.channel` | enum | yes | one of `message_channel` |

Other fields come from the `message` block.

```json
{
  "message": {
    "channel": "email"
  }
}
```
